{{Top|leg}}
'''Talesian thermal detonators''' were a type of [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] that were powerful enough to destroy a large building. Despite their great destructive power, they still fit nicely in a [[Human/Legends|Human's]] palm. Usually, such weapons were only used by [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorists]] who valued the destruction of their enemies more than their own lives. Despite that, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] once brought one with him on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], in hopes of killing [[Clan mother/Legends|Mother]] [[Gethzerion]] and her [[Coven/Legends|coven]] of [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]].
